title: Understand the changes in your coffee leaves.
introduction: A photo, a few answers, and a useful record for a local agricultural officer. Crop Health Assistant provides initial screening, not a confirmed diagnosis.
availabilityText: You can still add photos. Please try the check again later.

journey.title: Add leaf photos
journey.description: Take a clear photo of one affected coffee leaf in natural light.

journey.title: Share what you noticed
journey.description: Answer a few short questions. You can choose Not sure.

journey.title: Read the observations
journey.description: See visible symptoms, uncertainty and guidance suitable for your region, when available.

journey.title: Prepare a report
journey.description: Download a record to share with a local agricultural officer yourself.

uncertaintyText: A photo cannot confirm a disease or show that a plant is healthy.
regionalText: Guidance reviewed for PNG will not be assumed suitable everywhere. When local guidance is missing, we will explain that and suggest a local agricultural officer.
sessionTitle: One check in the open tab
sessionText: Photo checking needs internet. Refreshing or closing this tab clears your leaf check. Only your language choice is saved on this device.
footer: Coffee leaves only. We plan to test with PNG users first. Testing is still pending.
screeningStatement: A photo cannot confirm a disease.

assessment.intro: Coffee farmers everywhere are welcome. We plan to test the app with PNG users first. Agricultural expert review is still pending.
assessment.photoHelp: Use natural light and include the whole affected leaf. Add an underside photo when useful. Avoid faces, documents and identifying details.
assessment.limits: Choose JPEG, PNG or WebP photos, about 10 MB each and up to 40 megapixels. The app sends smaller copies, up to 1600 pixels on the longest side and about 2 MB each. If a photo is HEIC, save it as JPEG first.
assessment.privacy: Your photos and answers are sent to this app and Google when you choose Check photos or See result. The app does not keep a permanent copy. Google's rules on using and keeping data still apply. Only your language choice is saved on this device.
assessment.temporary: Refreshing or closing this tab clears your photos, answers and results. Downloads remain on your device until you delete them. Screening requires internet.
assessment.demoPrivacy: This service uses the free Gemini tier. Submit only sample data you have permission to share under Google's terms. Do not submit private farmer data.
assessment.paidPrivacy: Photos and answers are processed using Google's paid Gemini service.
assessment.permission: I have permission to submit these photos and answers.
assessment.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your photos and answers are still in this tab.
assessment.questionHelp: Choose an answer for each of the four questions. Not sure is a valid answer. No reviewed follow up questions are available yet.
assessment.confirmClear: Start a new check? This will clear your photos, answers and result from this tab.
assessment.countryHelp: Choose a listed country, or skip if yours is not listed. No exact location is needed.
assessment.countryEnglish: Country names are shown in English.
assessment.regionStale: Advice needs updating for your location. Update it before downloading.
assessment.coverage: The AI analyses visible changes and suggests possible causes. Its suggestions can be wrong. Independent agricultural evaluation is still pending.
assessment.unsupported: We can check coffee leaves only. Ask a local agricultural officer to review these photos.
assessment.initial: This photo check suggests possible causes. It cannot confirm a disease or guarantee that a plant is healthy.
assessment.noRegional: We do not have treatment advice checked for your country or region. For treatment decisions, ask a local agricultural officer to review this report.
assessment.unknownRegional: Your country or region is not known, so we cannot check which treatment advice applies. For treatment decisions, ask a local agricultural officer to review this report.
assessment.pngPending: Independent review by coffee farming experts is still pending. Published sources support the care suggestions, but experts have not yet checked this app’s advice for your country.
assessment.missing: What would help us understand more
assessment.noMissing: No other missing information was listed. The check limits still apply.
assessment.no_clear_supported_signs: No clear signs of a supported condition
assessment.reportHelp: The report uses the current photos, answers, region and checked observations. You choose who to share it with. Nothing is sent automatically to an officer.
assessment.downloaded: Your PDF is ready. Find it in your browser downloads.
assessment.exportError: We could not create the PDF. Your leaf check is still in this tab. Try again or choose Print report.
assessment.reportHeading: Crop Health Assistant leaf check report
assessment.processed: Photos are resized copies. Original photos remain on your device.
assessment.noResult: No screening result was produced. This report records a check that did not finish.
assessment.share: You choose who to share this report with. It is not sent to an officer automatically, and no officer review is promised.
assessment.automatic: These notes were translated automatically into Tok Pisin.
assessment.translationUnavailable: We could not translate these notes into Tok Pisin. You can choose to read them in English. Your photos will not be checked again.
assessment.englishFallback: Notes and photo limits are shown in English, as requested.
assessment.noTranslationExport: Choose Show notes in English before downloading this report.
assessment.needPermission: Tick the permission box before sending these photos and answers.
assessment.needAnswers: Choose an answer for all four questions. You can select Not sure.
assessment.needCountry: Choose a country, Not sure or Skip for now.
assessment.processing: Preparing the photo on this device
assessment.enableNote: Photo checking is paused. You can still add photos. Please try again later.

errors.disabled: Photo checking is paused. No result was produced. Your photos are still in this tab.
errors.unavailable: We could not check your photos right now. Your photos and answers are still in this tab. Try again later.
errors.timeout: The check took too long. Your photos and answers are still in this tab. Try again.
errors.invalid_input: Some information could not be accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.invalid_image: We could not open this photo. Choose a different JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.format: Choose a still photo in JPEG, PNG or WebP format. If the photo is HEIC, save it as JPEG first. Videos, moving images and documents cannot be used.
errors.too_large: The photo or submission exceeds the size limits. Choose a smaller photo.
errors.invalid_output: We could not finish the photo check. No result was produced. Try again.
errors.expired: Your check has expired. Choose Check photos to start again. Your photos and answers are still in this tab.
errors.busy: Another check is running. Wait, then try again.
errors.quota: You have reached the check limit. Wait before trying again. Your photos and answers are still in this tab.
errors.origin: This request must come from this app. Reload the app before retrying.
errors.demo_only: This service accepts only permitted sample data.
errors.translation_unavailable: Tok Pisin translation is unavailable. You can choose English observations.
errors.network: We could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.photo_failed: We could not prepare this photo. Choose a different JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.assessment_version_changed: The app has been updated. Your photos and answers are still here. Start a new photo check to use the update, or download an incomplete record first.

onset.label: When did you first notice these changes?

spread.label: Is this affecting one plant or several plants?

care_change.label: Have you changed how you water, shade or care for the plants?

assessment.introShort: A coffee leaf check for farmers everywhere.
assessment.photoHelpShort: Take a photo of the whole leaf in natural light. You can add a second photo of the bottom of the leaf.
assessment.fileHint: Up to 2 photos. JPEG, PNG or WebP, about 10 MB each.
assessment.privacyShort: When you check photos, your photos and answers go to this app and Google. Avoid faces and personal details.
assessment.coverageShort: AI suggests possible causes. A photo cannot confirm a diagnosis.
assessment.initialShort: A photo cannot confirm a disease or that a plant is healthy.
assessment.sessionShort: Keep this tab open. Refreshing clears your check. Internet is required.
assessment.questionsShort: Answer 4 questions. Choose Not sure whenever you need to.
assessment.photoDetails: Photo quality and what we see
assessment.reportShort: Save the PDF to keep or share your leaf check.
assessment.reportSummary: Your photos, answers and results are included. You choose who receives it.
assessment.noRegionalShort: Treatment advice checked for your area is not available. Ask a local agricultural officer before choosing treatment.
assessment.unknownRegionalShort: Your country is not selected, so local treatment advice cannot be checked. Ask a local agricultural officer before choosing treatment.
assessment.photoCheckComplete: Your photos were checked. This app cannot name a disease yet.

findings.changes_visible: Changes are visible on this leaf.
findings.no_clear_changes: No clear changes were identified in these photos.
findings.unsupported: This check supports coffee leaf photos.
findings.unclear_subject: The app could not identify a coffee leaf clearly.
findings.quality: These photos do not give a clear view of the leaf.
findings.unclear_observations: The app could not describe the visible changes clearly.

assessment.visualCaveat: The AI can describe visible changes. It cannot confirm the cause or how serious the problem is.
assessment.healthCaveat: A photo cannot confirm that the plant is healthy.
assessment.causeUnavailable: No useful possible cause was identified. See the specific explanation and missing information below.
assessment.excludedPhoto: Not used for the main finding
assessment.officerPhotoNote: For a local officer, you can also take a photo of the whole tree to show where leaves are affected. Keep it to share separately; upload only leaf photos here.
assessment.collectionHelp: These notes are optional. A new photo needs a new check.
assessment.noCollection: No additional collection request is listed. The check limits still apply.

collection.replace_unclear_photos: If possible, replace the unclear photos in natural light. Include the whole leaf.
collection.add_upper: If possible, collect a clear photo of the top of the leaf.
collection.add_underside: If possible, collect a clear photo of the bottom of the leaf.
collection.identify_sides: If possible, identify which side the photos show, or collect top and bottom views for a later check.
collection.record_onset: If known, record when you first noticed the leaf changes.
collection.record_spread: If known, record whether one or several plants are affected.

assessment.causeIntro: These are possible causes, not a confirmed diagnosis.
assessment.modelKnowledge: AI explanation without a supplied reference.
assessment.sourcesLimit: These sources describe symptoms. They have not reviewed your case or approved a treatment for your area. Source titles and scope are shown in English.
assessment.reportContents: Includes your photos, possible causes and what to check next.
assessment.reportUse: Also includes your answers and what the AI could not tell.
assessment.chooseAll: Choose all that apply, or choose Not sure.
assessment.startOverHelp: This clears this leaf check. Download your report first if you want to keep it.
assessment.careUnreviewed: Suggested from published sources. Not independently reviewed.
assessment.careHelper: These are general garden checks. The photo does not show which change is needed.
assessment.careNone: The photos do not support a specific care suggestion. Use the observation checks above.
assessment.careRegionUnknown: Choose your coffee-growing country to check which care sources apply. Not sure is also fine.
assessment.careNoRegion: We do not yet have suitable care sources for this country. Keep the observations and ask a local agricultural officer about treatment.
assessment.careSourceScope: Source scope: {country}. This is not a review of this app or your case.
assessment.careInvalid: Some optional advice could not be checked. Your photo findings are still available.
assessment.chemicalUnavailable: No current local product label has been verified for this case, so product names and spray doses are not shown.
assessment.chemicalNoEvidence: A chemical option needs clearer supporting evidence. A leaf photo does not confirm the cause.
assessment.chemicalUnknown: Choose a country before checking local chemical options.
assessment.chemicalEnglish: Chemical label details are available in English only. Choose Show English label details to read the questions and precautions.
assessment.chemicalIdentity: I have this exact product, concentration and formulation.
assessment.chemicalConditions: Can you meet these label conditions? Choose Not sure if you do not know.
assessment.chemicalPending: Complete the product check before viewing a label rate.
assessment.chemicalConditionsFailed: The label conditions have not all been confirmed. The rate is not shown.
assessment.chemicalExpired: This label check is out of date. The rate is not shown.
assessment.chemicalCaveat: Label information does not confirm the diagnosis or mean you should spray.
assessment.chemicalExportFailed: We could not refresh the label check. You can save a report without chemical rates.

careActions.pg_check_drainage: After rain, check whether existing drains are blocked.
careActions.pg_check_weeds: Check weeds around the coffee trees. If you remove them, avoid damaging roots and stems.
careActions.pg_review_garden_management: Check shade and how the coffee trees are pruned and fed.

assessment.chemicalEnglishReport: You chose to read the chemical label details below in English.
assessment.careBrazilScope: The Brazilian source mainly covers Arabica coffee. It does not establish advice for every coffee variety.
